title: Token usage / time / dollars still not visible (regression)
body:
John 2026-07-28 (general session on Puter, resume chain 402ac459 / dashboard general lane):

I am not seeing token usage, time, dollars spent — that was supposed to be fixed.

Prior friction 2026-07-26-02-usage-numbers-read-zero was marked resolved (commit 121b479, general lane rollup). Live product still does not surface usable spend to John.

Success criteria for sleep:
- On project dashboard / workbench tiles / session chrome: show real token usage, elapsed time, and dollars (or honest unmeasured state with reason — never silent zero that looks like free).
- Works for Claude, Gemini (agy), and Grok seats — including grok-no-claude-sidecar style unmeasured cases with a clear label, not blank.
- Stop/resume and run-cost pointers must roll into what the human sees without opening logs.
